transcript: Elon Musk has finally revealed the Roadster, and it can literally fly. It drove up a ramp upside down, did a flip mid-air, and landed using its air thrusters! It then jumped over a line of Teslas, including a Semi, and also hit 0 to 60 in just 0.81 seconds! But here's the catch: There are three versions of the car. And the flying version, Rocket, is invite-only with no approval for public roads. We don't even know if it's legal or not. Plus, there's still no price announced. caption: Tesla roadster can now…fly?!
